sql_query:
SELECT
  LEFT(o.order_id, 10) AS order_id,
  MAX(o.order_estimated_delivery_date) AS estimated_delivery_datetime,
  MAX(o.order_delivered_customer_date) AS actual_delivery_datetime,
  ABS(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (MAX(o.order_delivered_customer_date) - MAX(o.order_estimated_delivery_date))) / 3600.0) AS delivery_delay_hours
FROM
  orders o
WHERE
  o.order_status = 'delivered'
  AND o.order_estimated_delivery_date IS NOT NULL
  AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  LEFT(o.order_id, 10);
